description: Who holds a token and how the holders are connected: the top 40 holders with their share of supply, marked pool (venue), dev, contract or wallet, and clusters of wallets linked by moving the token between themselves (one sent tokens to another). Also the top-10 share outside pools. Use for 'who holds it?', 'is the supply concentrated?', 'bubble map'. Also takes a Solana mint: its 20 largest holders by owner, marked wallet, pool (labelled pump.fun, PumpSwap, Raydium, Orca or Meteora when known) or contract; linked wallets aren't read on Solana yet. Works for 0x tokens on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum and Base (pass chain, or it finds the chain); on Ethereum and Base the dev is whoever created the token's contract, and a very busy token is read from its most recent transfers.

chain.description: For a 0x address: the chain. Default: Robinhood Chain if the token is there, else Ethereum, else Base

token.description: Token contract address (0x...) on Robinhood Chain, Ethereum or Base, or a Solana mint
